title: Browser models for: The direct benefit of a second modified live core vaccine dose for adult shelter dogs and cats
description: Interactive browser models that estimate the second doses of modified live vaccine a shelter gives per case averted in adult cats (panleukopenia) and dogs (distemper, parvovirus), from a shelter's own length-of-stay records and case counts or from illustrative stays, and the effect of the day the second dose is given. They accompany the modeling paper of the same title.
